positive_plan_observations.observation: Authentication at event 0 precedes get_order at event 1. The canonical plan puts the read before authentication, but public policy permits authentication first. Exact action equality rejects this valid ordering.

All 72 primary artifacts are now present. Positive 4B traces received structured policy/state review, but this remains unblinded model-assisted review and does not create an independently sampled external label set. Positive 2B traces retain header-level screening rather than detailed adjudication.
selection_rule: Screen every completed primary trial for grader gaps. Retain the prior detailed review of all 14 2B failures. Review all 36 4B raw episodes against policy/state obligations and annotate both failures. Inspect three valid 4B alternative-plan examples. This is model-assisted unblinded review, not independent external labels.
